nwerc/ (per-year 1988-2025 under /archive/<year>/nwerc|nwercpc/) - Northwestern Europe Regional Contest incl. legacy ERC (1988-91) and WERC (1992-94) names - ALREADY MINED
bapc/ + nkp/ (per-year 1991-2025) - Benelux Algorithm Programming Contest incl. legacy NKP 'Nederlands Kampioenschap Programmeren' era (1991-2004/2006) - ALREADY MINED

dapc/ (per-year 1990-2025) - Delft Algorithm Programming Contest (TU Delft local / BAPC preliminary), incl. legacy DKP 'Delfts Kampioenschap Programmeren', VNKP and SWEP names; problemset.pdf/solution

fpc/ (per-year 2005-2026, gaps: 2006-07, 2012) - Freshmen Programming Contest (TU Delft freshmen), incl. legacy SKP 'Sjaars Kampioenschap Programmeren' and DnAKP names; problemset.pdf per year - NO ca
euc/ (2023, 2024) - ICPC European Championship problem-set.pdf + solutions.pdf/zip + scoreboard.html - NEW, harvested as euc-2024/euc-2025

icpcarchive.github.io is the single biggest new vein: community mirror (contact icpcarchive@gmail.com, hosted on GitHub Pages, no official affiliation) with uniform '<Category>/<Contest>/<Year> <Contest>/problems.pdf|solution.pdf' layout.
